title: DuoCL: Dual-Path Online Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online continual learning (OCL) requires learning from a data stream whose arrival rate is independent of model training speed. When training cannot keep pace, computationally expensive gradient-based methods update less frequently, limiting adaptation. Analytic methods reduce this overhead, but their frozen backbones cannot adapt representations to changing distributions. We propose DuoCL, a dual-path OCL framework whose fast analytic path accumulates feature statistics from every incoming minibatch while its slow path periodically adapts the backbone. The slow path adjusts its sample count to the available compute budget without interrupting fast-path learning. Feature alignment compensates for drift in the accumulated classifier statistics. translated_abstract: 在线持续学习（OCL）要求模型从数据流中学习，而数据流的到达速率与模型训练速度无关。当训练速度跟不上数据到达速度时，计算开销较大的基于梯度的方法更新频率会降低，从而限制了模型的适应能力。解析方法虽然降低了这种开销，但其冻结的骨干网络无法使表征适应不断变化的分布。我们提出了DuoCL，这是一个双路径OCL框架：其快速解析路径从每个传入的小批量数据中累积特征统计信息，而其慢速路径则周期性地对骨干网络进行适应。慢速路径可根据可用的计算预算调整其处理的样本数量，且不会中断快速路径的学习。特征对齐机制补偿了累积分类器统计信息中的漂移。在四个数据集和三种计算预算下，DuoCL在每种设置中相比最强的基于梯度的基线方法，平均将在线准确率提升了9.67个百分点。
tldr: DuoCL通过结合快速解析学习路径与慢速骨干网络适应路径的双路径框架，在保证在线学习不间断的前提下自适应计算预算，相比基于梯度的基线方法平均提升在线准确率9.67个百分点。
en_tdlr: DuoCL is a dual-path online continual learning framework that combines a fast analytic path with a slow backbone-adaptation path, improving online accuracy by an average of 9.67 percentage points over gradient-based baselines across varying compute budgets.
